name: monitor_create
summary: Watch a search on a listings site (willhaben, ImmoScout24, eBay, Kleinanzeigen, Amazon, Facebook Marketplace, any results page) on a schedule and alert the user whenever a NEW listing that matches appears; filters for place / Vienna district, price, free items ('zu verschenken') and private sellers. Use for 'tell me when…', 'let me know if a new … shows up', 'check … every hour/day', 'monitor/watch …'. The first run stores what is there now.

args.name: string: short label, e.g. 'Trenchcoat gratis Wien'
args.site: willhaben | immoscout_at | immoscout_de | ebay_de | ebay_at | kleinanzeigen | amazon_de | fb_marketplace | other
args.query: string: the item in a few words (things), or extra words for flats (e.g. 'balkon')
args.place: string: city / Bundesland / Vienna district ('Wien', 'Wien 7', '1070', 'Graz', 'Berlin', 'München') — things and flats
args.free: bool: only free items ('zu verschenken', 'gratis', 'gives away')
args.url: string: ONLY for site=other — that site's search URL with the filters, newest first
args.interval_min: int: minutes between checks (default 60; 15-30 for free items and fast markets, 360 or 1440 for slow ones)
